description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Appointing members of the Wages Board for the Bakery Trade for a period of 03 years commencing on 01.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the appointment of members to the Wages Board for the Bakery Trade under the Wages Boards Ordinance. The content primarily deals with the establishment of a regulatory body and the exercise of powers granted by existing legislation (Wages Boards Ordinance Chapter 136). This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it concerns the implementation and operation of a statutory regulatory framework for labor standards, rather than being primarily about government personnel changes (which would lack the detailed portfolio responsibilities for a Hybrid classification) or organizational structure changes.
